page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.8xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core. This configuration does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and providing a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core metrics, including stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, fall into the bottom 25% tier, reflecting the older processor architecture. Conversely, multi-core performance is average, with the 32 dedicated physical cores delivering stable throughput in multi-threaded decompression, software compilation, and static web serving. Memory bandwidth remains moderate, though overall memory latency tests show weaker relative performance.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn1ne.8xlarge offers a high density of dedicated physical cores at a lower resource-density cost, making it a viable option for parallelizable workloads that do not require the latest instruction sets or high single-thread performance. It is well-suited for multi-threaded applications, software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation without requiring massive memory footprints.
